inputs.waterC: mean sea surface temperature of the month (offer_climate_stats.water_temp_months)
inputs.airMaxC: mean daily max air temperature of the month (offer_climate_stats.air_temp_max_months)
inputs.windKn: mean 10 m wind on kiteable days, knots - not in our data yet, pass null

rule: base level = first level (warm to cold) whose waterMinC <= waterC; the last level has no lower bound
airStep = 1 when airMaxC < base.waterMinC + airMarginC (never for the coldest level)
level = base + airStep + windStep, capped at the coldest level
boots / gloves / hood from waterC: below recommendedBelowC = recommended, below optionalBelowC = optional, else no
airMaxC < coldAirC makes gloves and hood recommended

levels.label: 3/4 suit: short-arm full or long john (2 mm)
